name: ANSI/IEEE Ultrasonic proximity switch form
summary: IEEE-library form of ultrasonic proximity switch: an ultrasonic-switch representation identifies presence or distance switching using an ultrasonic sensing principle.
description: This reference locates ultrasonic proximity switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented ultrasonic switches family. An ultrasonic-switch representation identifies presence or distance switching using an ultrasonic sensing principle. The public library uses HPX1U for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
